doc: Formal criteria for .cursor/rules/*.mdc. Each failed criterion emits one finding (penalty 1). Skipped when no .mdc files exist (missing rules uses missingRulesPenalty).

criteria.label: Valid YAML frontmatter
criteria.message: Every .mdc rule must start with YAML frontmatter between --- delimiters.

criteria.label: Non-empty description
criteria.message: Every rule must declare a non-empty description field in frontmatter.

criteria.label: Scope declared
criteria.message: Every rule must set alwaysApply: true or a non-empty globs pattern.

criteria.label: Minimum body content
criteria.message: Rule body must contain at least 5 non-empty lines after frontmatter.

criteria.label: Repository overview rule
criteria.message: At least one rule must have alwaysApply: true or globs covering **/*.

criteria.label: Rule length cap
criteria.message: No single rule file may exceed 150 lines (create-rule recommends under 50).

criteria.label: mdc-only directory
criteria.message: .cursor/rules/ must contain only .mdc rule files (no .md, .txt, etc.).

criteria.label: Unique descriptions
criteria.message: Each rule description must be unique across all rules.
